title: anthriscus vulgaris var. trichosperma
intro: Anthriscus vulgaris var. trichosperma, commonly known as Wild Celery or Cow Parsley, is a biennial plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include acting as a natural anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic, and is used to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Wild Celery include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote better sleep. Its bioactive constituents include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
